text:
alex: Quick retro from today's spot fallback sprint — wanted to capture what we learned and next steps. TL;DR: mixed-pool fallback worked in most cases, but we saw ~15% request errors for models pinned to NVLink nodes during simulated preempts.

maria: Can you summarise the biggest failure modes?

alex: Two main things: 1) autoscaler throttle on launch templates delayed on-demand spinups; 2) some subnets rejected metadata requests which stalled LB drain.

sre-oncall: Observed 95th latency jump on /v1/complete for small-batch infer. KV cache misses spiked right after eviction injection.

jordan: deploy-bot: eviction-injector triggered 50 node preempts in us-west-2-a at 14:23 UTC — sim-id=evict-2026-03-18

ops-bot: auto-remediation engaged: mixed-pool-failover policy rerouted traffic -> on-demand and switched some routes to quantized variants (llama-7b-q4).

lee: I tried a manual drain on a stuck node and it hung. Anyone have the exact commands we ran?

alex: ```bash
# simulate eviction
kubectl label node gpu-*-usw2 preempt=force
kubectl drain gpu-12-usw2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

maria: The drain hung because the CNI hit ENI limits on the instance family; pods were Terminating waiting for network detachment.

sre-oncall: Proposal: add a preemptible readiness probe that fails fast so the scheduler can evict/recreate pods sooner rather than waiting for in-pod cleanup.

jordan: Also recommend a warm-pool of 2 on-demand GPUs per AZ for critical shards. Ballpark cost +$6k/month but avoids SLO hits.

alex: Agreed. Also we need staged rollouts for fallback. Today the fallback flipped most traffic at once, causing downstream overloads. Canary-first -> ramp -> full.

maria: Action items: (1) warm-pool per AZ; (2) fix autoscaler launch rate limits; (3) implement preemptible readiness probe; (4) add ENI limit test to infra CI.

lee: I'll take #1 and #4. @jordan take #2. @maria take #3.

jordan: On it. I'll coordinate with cloud-ops to pre-warm AMIs and check launch quotas. May need to bump account limits.

deploy-bot: sim-run report: 50 evictions, 12 nodes failed graceful drain, 38 successful; traffic redirected to on-demand; error-rate peaked at 18% for ~3m, SLO breach for ~2m.

sre-oncall: We also missed an automated unpin for a model that was pinned to NVLink hardware — that created a hotspot. Need auto-unpin + variant swap.

alex: Add automated unpin + temporary switch to quantized model variant on preempt event. Should be part of the failover policy.

maria: For the retro: propose measurable success criteria for these exercises: <1% increase in errors, <30s additional tail latency, and full fallback without manual intervention.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Policy staged: mixed-pool-fallback-v2. Simulation tags will be included in logs for easier filtering.

lee: I'll schedule a follow-up focused mini-sprint next Wed 15:00 PT — short window to validate ENI and autoscaler fixes.

jordan: Finance sign-off for warm-pools? @finance we estimated ~$6k/mo.

finance: acked. Please put formal request in cost-ticket and tag me.

maria: Filing infra/4721 with logs, sim artifacts, and deploy manifests.

alex: Thanks everyone — solid learnings. We'll track action items in infra/4721 and reconvene after the mini-sprint. :thumbsup:
